title: University of Mary Hardin-Baylor (UMHB) customer story
subject: University of Mary Hardin-Baylor (UMHB) customer story
body:
A strong modernization story gets even stronger when customers can see how others are putting it into practice.

The University of Mary Hardin-Baylor customer story gives you real-world proof to support conversations around modern infrastructure, reliable access to data and simpler operations.

Use the story to make the conversation more tangible, then keep the momentum going with the Data Platform, Architecture & Economics campaign.
